decision_architecture_variants.description: Current contextual Stage 4 information-isolated three-lens evaluation with the frozen upstream Stage 1-3 chain and deterministic downstream policy held fixed.
Joint three-lens Stage 4 single-agent baseline over the same frozen contextual DecisionObjects/evidence and the same deterministic downstream policy.

decision_policy_variants.description: Technical and Institutional are critical feasibility gates; Financial is the adoption gate.
Critical gates retain the main semantics, but unresolved Financial/Adoption yields HOLD instead of RECOMMEND_PILOT.
If both critical gates are supported, Financial/Adoption challenge or unresolved status is limited to RECOMMEND_PILOT rather than HOLD.

prompt_paraphrase_variants.description: Canonical main prompt wording used by the frozen Stage 1-6 run.
Semantically equivalent wording that asks for evidence inventory and boundaries before role judgment while preserving the same output contract and evidence access.
Semantically equivalent wording that states the role decision question first and then the same evidence, modality, temporal, and provenance constraints.
